text: When he reached the farmer's house, and squeezing himself through a tiny little hole way down in the corner of the kitchen door, went behind the kitchen stove to hide. There wasn't a sound to be heard, only the old kitchen clock, he said. Tick-tock, tick-tock, tick-tock. But the silly little mouse thought the clock said, come in,
